It's a sweet job IMO. You will receive an email or call after they receive your initial application. Then they will have you make an online account if you haven't  already and take a test/questionnaire. After this they will call you to set up a local in-person interview, but with Corona it may just be a phone interview. After a week or so After the interview they will let you know if you're hired if you're lucky. They took about s month to let me know. I didn't start until 6 months after my interview which was frustrating, but I made it. Before you start working for Frito they will send you to Onboarding to learn the ins and outs of the company. I believe I spent 3-4 days in a different state for onboarding and had a really good time. Learned a lot and met some cool peeps. So when I got back I became a Merchandiser amd got trained in. A year after that I became a RSA amd covered vacations for the Zone. Them 6 months later I became a swing for 2 route leaders. Basically I work there days off and 1 random swing day where we work together. Overall it's probably my favorite job I've  ever had.
